summary: Google DeepMind published a patch release for its science-skills repository fixing MIME type handling and API endpoint URLs for two bioinformatics data integrations.

practices.reason: Bug fixes to API client URLs and MIME types for existing integrations create minor upkeep but no new work beyond updating the dependency.
practices.quote: Human Protein Atlas: Amend the http client url to unify search API and XML endpoints under www.proteinatlas.org which always serves the latest release.
